acceptanceCriteria: a spec proposal for journal-optional reads and adopt/import exists
init refuses when committed tickets exist, with a test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §5 disputed item 4. The journal is bound to one clone: fresh clones, CI and cloud sessions get UNINITIALIZED, and init over existing tickets freezes the store (journal/records.go:488), per SPEC §3.4. Sharpest part: init must refuse when tickets already exist. Proposal: journal-optional reads plus init --adopt or import. Related: V1-0171.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by adafe83f and eba6fbad (PR #289): init refuses over existing records and committed tickets (TestCTSV0001_InitRefusesOverExistingRecords, TestCTSV0001_InitRefusesOverCommittedTickets); journal-optional reads (CTS-V0-002) and foreign roadmap import as shadow IMPORT records (CTS-V0-003) are specified and tested. Adopting committed native records is an explicit non-goal of the spec. Re-verified 2026-10-08 at main ecfff8e0 with filtered tasks/cli, tasks/store and tasks/importer runs (all pass); full store package not rerun. Evidence digests are sha256 of the cited files at ecfff8e0. Manual completion; no new CEM.

title: corvint-tasks: init over existing tickets freezes the store; add journal-optional reads and init --adopt/import
